mapper.select: SELECT id AS userId, login_id AS username, name, email, phone, created_at AS createdAt, password, role FROM user WHERE id = #{userId}

SELECT r.id AS reservationId, s.name AS stationName, r.reservation_type AS reservationType, r.status, rt.start_time AS startTime, rt.end_time AS endTime, rtg.target_kwh AS targetAmount, c.connector_type AS connectorType FROM reservation r LEFT JOIN reservation_time rt ON r.id = rt.reservation_id LEFT JOIN reservation_target rtg ON r.id = rtg.reservation_id JOIN charger c ON r.charger_id = c.id JOIN station s ON c.station_id = s.id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.status IN ('RESERVED', 'CHARGING') ORDER BY rt.start_time ASC

SELECT r.id AS reservationId, s.name AS stationName, r.reservation_type AS reservationType, r.status, rt.start_time AS startTime, rt.end_time AS endTime, rtg.target_kwh AS targetAmount, c.connector_type AS connectorType FROM reservation r LEFT JOIN reservation_time rt ON r.id = rt.reservation_id LEFT JOIN reservation_target rtg ON r.id = rtg.reservation_id JOIN charger c ON r.charger_id = c.id JOIN station s ON c.station_id = s.id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.status IN ('COMPLETED', 'CANCELED', 'EXPIRED') ORDER BY rt.start_time DESC

SELECT r.id AS reservationId, r.reservation_type AS reservationType, r.status, rt.start_time AS startTime, rt.end_time AS endTime, rtg.target_kwh AS targetAmount, s.name AS stationName FROM reservation r LEFT JOIN reservation_time rt ON r.id = rt.reservation_id LEFT JOIN reservation_target rtg ON r.id = rtg.reservation_id JOIN charger c ON r.charger_id = c.id JOIN station s ON c.station_id = s.id WHERE r.id = #{reservationId}
